guitar.evidence: Isaac Hayes was a singer/songwriter/composer (Theme From Shaft), not primarily a guitarist; session guitarists (e.g. Bobby Womack on some sessions) varied.
guitar.notes: Correctly left unknown — not a guitar-led act.

tone.target: wah-driven clean funk with tight mid punch
tone.profile: wah-driven clean funk with tight mid punch
tone.summary: A tight, funky signal chain utilizing a light boost and US Deluxe amp model paired with a Wah pedal for rhythmic sweeps. The focus is on clarity and mid-range definition.
corrections: keep wah as the main signature

rig.name: Isaac Hayes - Theme From Shaft - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm.
Provide a subtle lift and punch to the signal without adding grit.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used for clean tone shaping, mimicking a light boost pedal's role in funk.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the signature rhythmic wah sweeps required for funk.
Provide clean edge-of-breakup and punch without heavy grit.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its relatively transparent, mid-focused breakup character suitable for funk.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, punchy sound of a Fender-style amp.
Match the required small cabinet size and clean tone profile.
Enhance the mid-range punch and tighten the low end.
blocks.gap: Used to manually sculpt the tone for maximum funk clarity, compensating for potential muddiness.

blocks.purpose: Included as a fallback for subtle movement, but kept inactive per 'avoid' list.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is listed in the allowed modules but explicitly avoided by the musical verdict. It is included here only to meet minimum block count requirements while remaining functionally bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without sounding wash-out.
blocks.gap: A minimal delay is used to add dimension, keeping the funk feel dry and tight.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better definition and tightness.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punchy, defined sound required for funk/soul.
